business_summary: Deere & Company manufactures and distributes various equipment worldwide. It operates through four segments: Production and Precision Agriculture, Small Agriculture and Turf, Construction and Forestry, and Financial Services. The Production and Precision Agriculture segment provides track and row crop tractors, harvesters, cotton pickers and strippers, sugarcane harvesters and loaders, soil preparation, tillage, seeding, and crop care equipment; and application equipment, such as sprayers and nutrient management, soil preparation machinery, and related attachments and service parts. The Small Agriculture and Turf segment offers specialty, utility, and compact tractors; self-propelled forage harvesters and attachments; rotary mowers, hay and forage equipment, and utility vehicles; turf and utility equipment, including riding lawn, commercial mowing, and golf course equipment, and utility vehicles, as well as implements for mowing, tilling, snow and debris handling, aerating, residential, commercial, golf, and sports turf care applications. The Construction and Forestry segment provides backhoe loaders, crawler dozers and loaders, loaders, excavators, motor graders, articulated dump trucks, skid-steer loaders, milling machines, recyclers, slipform and asphalt pavers, surface miners, compactors, tandem, static rollers, mobile crushers and screens, mobile and stationary asphalt plants, and log harvesters; and road building and rehabilitation equipment. The Financial Services segment finances sales and leases agriculture and turf, and construction and forestry equipment. It also offers wholesale financing to dealers of the foregoing equipment; and extended equipment warranties. It has a strategic partnership with Tarter USA to develop and produce flex wing rotary cutters. It also has strategic partnership with Yamaha Motor Corporation, Usa to co-develop future side-by-side vehicles. The company was founded in 1837 and is headquartered in Moline, Illinois.
business_summary_ko: Deere & Company는 전 세계적으로 다양한 장비를 제조 및 유통합니다. 생산 및 정밀 농업, 소규모 농업 및 잔디, 건설 및 임업, 금융 서비스 등 4개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 생산 및 정밀 농업 부문은 육상 작물 트랙터, 수확기, 면화 수확기 및 스트리퍼, 사탕수수 수확기 및 로더, 토양 준비, 경작, 파종 및 작물 관리 장비를 제공합니다. 분무기 및 영양분 관리, 토양 준비 기계, 관련 부착물 및 서비스 부품과 같은 적용 장비. 소규모 농업 및 잔디 부문은 특수, 유틸리티 및 소형 트랙터를 제공합니다. 자체 추진 마초 수확기 및 부착물; 회전식 잔디 깎는 기계, 건초 및 마초 장비, 다용도 차량; 잔디밭 타기, 상업용 잔디 깎기, 골프 코스 장비, 다용도 차량을 포함한 잔디 및 유틸리티 장비뿐만 아니라 예초, 경작, 눈 및 잔해 처리, 공기 공급, 주거용, 상업용, 골프 및 스포츠 잔디 관리 응용 분야를 위한 도구. 건설 및 임업 부문에서는 백호 로더, 크롤러 도저 및 로더, 로더, 굴삭기, 모터 그레이더, 굴절식 덤프를 제공합니다.
